description: This file implements the QuickHull algorithm for computing convex hulls of geographic points, integrated with Leaflet marker clusters.

classes.name: L.QuickHull
classes.description: A static object providing methods to compute convex hulls using the QuickHull algorithm.

methods.name: getDistant
methods.description: Calculates an approximate distance from a point to a baseline.

methods.name: findMostDistantPointFromBaseLine
methods.description: Finds the point furthest from a baseline within a set of points.

methods.name: buildConvexHull
methods.description: Recursively builds the convex hull from a baseline and set of points.

methods.name: getConvexHull
methods.description: Computes the convex hull of a set of geographic points.
